verdict.rationale: ROS 2's own docs include a tutorial for launching a Gazebo simulation, which gives a test environment separate from the physical robot. Rosbag recording and playback also lets recorded or synthetic data be replayed in tests. However, the simulator is a separate project integrated through a tutorial, and the evidence is mostly titles and one-line mentions rather than documented isolation from production. missing for 10: explicit documentation of sandbox/production isolation (e.g. separating sim from live robot graphs), in-depth simulation workflow docs, hands-on corroboration of agent-driven testing in sim.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Goal: Launch a Simulation with Gazebo and ROS 2
it is also possible to save data generated by another source than a topic, such as synthetic data for training sets.
ROS gives you data bagging, visualization, teleop and sim 'for free' if you follow its conventions
